_comment: Tier-2 for fenics poisson#0: which boundary idiom still needs create_connectivity on dolfinx 0.10.0. The claim has two halves that pull in opposite directions, which is the point of the entry: * locate_entities_boundary / locate_dofs_topological build the connectivity lazily, so omitting mesh.topology.create_connectivity(fdim, tdim) does NOT raise any more (it did pre-0.7); * dolfinx.mesh.exterior_facet_indices(mesh.topology) is still EAGER and raises on a fresh mesh. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 on dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
expect_in_output: Facet to cell connectivity has not been computed
